description: Pyseidon groups and visualises water-flow and demand patterns and connects to WNTR for network simulation. This resource is provided by Yerdana2002 (repository owner). Its method is not tied to one place; geographic inputs and simulation resolution depend on the user configuration. Access is through the linked repository or provider page; the exact file formats are not fully established. Licence: MIT. The public page or repository can be accessed free of charge. Limitation: Its README makes an outdated-looking Python compatibility assertion about WNTR; do not adopt that dependency claim without checking the current package. For simulation, it can support model preparation or execution. Related catalogue record: model-wntr. The relationship follows the named method or resource; it does not certify file compatibility.
